en.quote: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers. The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
en.riddle: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
en.speaker: the deep

he.speaker: תְּהוֹם
